name: Omnipresence
overview: Scripture reveals God's omnipresence as His constant and unbounded presence throughout all creation. The LORD's eyes observe every human action and movement, seeing both good and evil everywhere (Job 34:21; Proverbs 15:3). No one can escape His presence, as He fills heaven and earth and is intimately near to the contrite and humble (Jeremiah 23:24; Isaiah 57:15). His presence brings comfort and protection through all trials, assuring believers that He is with them in every circumstance (Psalms 139:7; Isaiah 43:2).
